explanation: Among people of the same gender, steady eye contact in the UAE is read as sincere and engaged, consistent with the warm, direct greeting style described in Emirati hospitality customs. Between men and women who are not closely related, however, prolonged eye contact can be seen as overly forward, so a more measured gaze is the safer default in mixed-gender business settings.
local_tip: Hold steady eye contact with someone of your own gender, but keep it brief and polite when speaking with the opposite gender in a business setting.

also_check.note: Sustained eye contact can feel confrontational; brief, softer eye contact is the norm.
Steady eye contact is expected in business as a signal of confidence and honesty.
Prolonged eye contact with someone senior or older can be read as a challenge rather than respect.

sources.title: A Handshake is Worth 1000 Words: Body Language in Dubai Business Culture
